parent_objective: fresh repeat and wrong-history coverage audit for outcome-critical selector

public_gates: repeat outcome-critical selector on fresh source-diverse matched-current artifacts
audit whether wrong-history or delayed-history rows become outcome-critical
separate margin-gap-only evidence from success-drop evidence
decide between wrong-history gate expansion and task-family redesign
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change actor input/output contract
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim wrong-history proof from reset/zero-current rows
hypothesis: M461's selector can find outcome-critical reset/zero-current rows, but fresh repeat is needed to test robustness and determine whether wrong-history belief evidence exists.
success_criteria: fresh repeat completes without scenario sampling failure
selector outputs compact corpus or structured rejection
success-drop and margin-gap evidence are reported separately
failure_criteria: wrong-history absence is hidden in aggregate counts
margin-gap-only evidence is treated as success proof

commands.name: outcome_critical_selector_repeat_audit
commands.command: Run fresh matched-current/action/outcome artifacts through the M461 selector and audit wrong-history coverage; no training.

decision_rule: M462 can admit wrong-history gate expansion only if fresh selected rows include wrong-history outcome-critical evidence. It cannot promote a checkpoint.
next_blocker: pending M462 outcome-critical selector repeat audit
